gameDescriptionHtml:
Start your own photography studio! Hire staff, upgrade your interior, and manage your business to attract more customers. Transform your humble studio into a full-scale photography base. Invite models, build relationships, go on dates, and unlock exclusive private photo shoots.

Game Features

  • Studio Management – Manage and expand your photography studio, from opening to closing, with every detail under your control.
  • Street Photography Tasks – Complete various outdoor shooting tasks and specific missions in the pedestrian street to earn money and likes, boosting your shop’s popularity.
  • NPC Interaction – Interact with NPCs on the street, increase favorability by giving gifts and completing tasks, unlocking more features and rewards.
  • Pose Design – Design and pose customer shots, adjusting every joint in detail to create unique photography works.
  • Custom Photoshoots – Serve various types of customers, including regular, VIP, and celebrity clients, fulfilling their shooting needs.
  • Equipment Upgrades – Continuously upgrade and add new photography equipment and tools by earning income and completing tasks, improving shooting quality and efficiency.
  • Employee Management – Hire staff to help manage your studio, streamlining your workflow.
